stick.weapon_release.name: Weapon release
stick.weapon_release.note: red weapon release button on the top left of the head

stick.hat.tms.name: TMS hat
stick.hat.tms.note: sensor control 4-way switch in the centre of the head

stick.hat.dms.name: DMS hat
stick.hat.dms.note: weapon select castle switch on the left front of the grip

stick.trigger.name: Trigger

unplaced.stick.pinky.lever: paddle on the lower front of the grip, not visible from this side

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the WinWing F/A-18 grip alone (no base) seen from the pilot's left side, slightly from above; front of the grip to the left
mappingSource: catalog vpforce.json (source https://docs.vpforce.eu/products/grip-adapters/): control names only, no input numbers (Rhino numbering set by the Configurator); identities by the F/A-18 stick layout as in the Thrustmaster F/A-18C grip manual (https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/Manuals/FA18C/FA-18C_Hornet_Add-On_user_manual.pdf): TMS = sensor control switch (centre of the head), DMS = weapon select castle switch (left front), trim hat with NOSE UP marking, red weapon release top left
note: The paddle (autopilot / NWS disengage lever) is on the lower front of the grip and is not visible from this side; the red button low on the front is the lower (undesignate/NWS) button, not a catalog part. The small round button below the trim is not a catalog part. The photo shows the grip only, so the gimbal is not marked.
